newsitem.title: USA: Zenith names Peter Willmott CEO, president.
newsitem.headline: Zenith names Peter Willmott CEO, president.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said it named interim chief executive Peter Willmott to be permanent president and chief executive.
Willmott is former president, chief operating officer and chief financial officer of Federal Express Corp and former CEO of retailer Carson Pirie Scott & Co.
Willmott, 59, has been a member of Zenith's board since 1990, the company said.
The Zenith board also elected John Koo, president and chief executive of LG Electronics Inc, as Zenith vice chairman, the company said.
